cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says children receive a number when their birth is registered.
cells.note: Rebuild: the NIR's Enrolment at Birth gives ID numbers to under-sixes, with a pilot in three counties launched in January 2025, so stage 2. Enrolment is separate from birth registration and was to begin; the first pass left it unplaced on the 2023 date.
